title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you detail-driven, organised, and ready to take the next step in your finance career? We re looking for a proactive Part Time Assistant Accountant to support a busy Finance department and play a key role in keeping operations running smoothly.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a collaborative, forward-thinking company where your skills will make a real difference. You ll be involved in a wide range of finance activities from managing daily cashbooks and handling multi-currency transactions to supporting month-end processes and ensuring excellent communication across teams.

This role is 20 hours per week (3 full days or spread across 5 days) hours can be discussed on application.

What You ll Be Doing
- Managing daily cashbooks and reconciling multi-currency bank accounts.
- Processing purchase and sales ledger tasks issuing statements, chasing overdue invoices, logging invoices, and preparing payment runs.
- Handling international transactions, supplier payments, petty cash, staff expenses, and credit card reconciliations.
- Supporting month-end processes, including closing ledgers and preparing key reports.
- Working with HMRC requirements, such as deferred duty accounts, postponed VAT, and monthly exchange rates.
- Uploading payroll files and supporting online banking activities.
- Maintaining strong credit control practices and building relationships with customers and suppliers.

What We re Looking For
- Proven experience in an accounts or finance administration role.
- Strong understanding of sales and purchase ledger processes.
- Confidence handling multi-currency transactions.
- Experience with online banking platforms and payroll uploads.
- Proficiency with accounting/finance systems and MS Office (especially Excel).
- Excellent attention to detail, organisation, and communication skills.
- Ability to manage deadlines, resolve queries, and build professional relationships across all levels.

Personal Qualities
- Trustworthy and able to handle sensitive financial information.
- Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
- Professional, approachable, and solution focused.

Why Join Us?

You ll be part of a supportive team where your contributions are valued, and your career can grow. We offer a dynamic work environment, the chance to work closely with senior management, and the opportunity to build your expertise in an international finance setting.

If you re ready to bring your skills, enthusiasm, and eye for detail to a role where no two days are the same, we d love to hear from you!

If you don t hear from us within 5 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this position. We appreciate your interest and encourage you to apply for future opportunities with us.

title: Accounts Receivable Assistant
description:
Howett Thorpe is recruiting two temporary Accounts Receivable Assistants to support an international business as it prepares to launch Microsoft Dynamics 365 alongside wider operational changes at the beginning of November.

This hands-on assignment will suit someone who enjoys investigating account discrepancies, resolving customer queries and ensuring financial records are accurate. Working closely with the finance team, you will help check customer balances and support a smooth transition between systems.

Job Title: Accounts Receivable Assistant
Job Type: Temporary two positions
Location: Farnborough
Salary: £13.45 £13.85 per hour
Reference: 16181

Accounts Receivable Assistant Benefits
- Hybrid working
- Free car parking
- Excellent on-site facilities

Accounts Receivable Assistant About the Role

You will join the finance team during a significant period of change, providing additional support ahead of the new system going live and throughout the transition.

With a particular focus on accounts receivable, you will help ensure customer account information, outstanding balances and payment allocations are accurate, while supporting customer enquiries and day-to-day finance activity. Your responsibilities will include:
- Speaking with customers and responding to enquiries about invoices, payments and outstanding balances.
- Investigating customer account queries and working with colleagues to resolve discrepancies.
- Reconciling sales ledger accounts and supporting bank reconciliation work.
- Checking receipts and payment allocations, identifying differences requiring further investigation.
- Supporting checks on customer information and balances transferred to Dynamics 365.
- Maintaining clear records of queries and reconciliation issues, escalating unresolved matters appropriately.
- Helping maintain day-to-day accounts receivable activity throughout the changeover.

The Successful Accounts Receivable Assistant Will Have:
- Previous experience in accounts receivable, sales ledger or a similar transactional finance role.
- Practical reconciliation experience and the ability to investigate account discrepancies.
- Confidence communicating with customers by telephone and email.
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to checking financial information.
- Good Excel skills and the ability to learn new finance systems.
- The ability to prioritise work and contribute effectively within a busy finance team.

Previous involvement in a finance systems implementation, particularly supporting activity before and after go-live, would be highly advantageous. Experience of Dynamics 365 would also be beneficial. This assignment offers the opportunity to contribute to a significant finance systems implementation, using your receivables experience to support accurate customer accounts and a smooth transition.

title: Payroll & Accounts Administrator (Part-time)
description:
Payroll & Accounts Administrator (Part-time)

Andover, Hampshire Fully Office Based
£22,000-£24,500 per annum (pro-rata), depending on experience and skills
27.5 hours per week Monday-Friday

About the Client

Our client is an established Automotive organisation with around 25 locations and 250 employees. Based within a six-person finance team in Andover, you will join a collaborative environment where accuracy, accountability and taking ownership are valued.

About the Job

This is a part-time opportunity offering genuine payroll responsibility, making it particularly well suited to an experienced payroll professional seeking reduced hours without moving into a junior or purely administrative role.

You will take ownership of a four-weekly payroll, ensuring accurate processing, thorough reconciliation and compliance with UK payroll requirements. You will also support purchase ledger and wider finance administration when required.

Duties will include:
- Taking ownership of accurate and timely payroll processing.
- Completing payroll reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Processing sickness information and completing holiday calculations.
- Resolving payroll queries and maintaining accurate records.
- Keeping up to date with UK payroll legislation and applying relevant changes.
- Using Excel extensively for reconciliations, data checks and analysis.
- Supporting purchase ledger and general accounts administration.
- Working closely with finance colleagues and the wider branch network.
- Using Cascade and an industry-specific legacy system, with training provided on unfamiliar systems.

About the Successful Applicant

You will ideally have at least two years' practical payroll experience, with the confidence to take ownership rather than simply process data. Strong Excel skills, particularly for reconciliations and data checking, and a sound understanding of UK payroll legislation are important. You will be accurate, organised and inquisitive, naturally investigating discrepancies and resolving queries. Purchase ledger experience is useful but not essential, and no formal payroll qualification is required.

What You Will Receive in Return

The basic salary is £22,000-£24,500 per annum, negotiable depending on experience and skills. Based on the reduced hours, this represents a strong full-time equivalent salary.

You will work 27.5 hours per week, completing 5.5 hours each day Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work those hours between 8:30am and 5:00pm. Please note that this position is fully office based in Andover five days per week.

Benefits include private medical insurance on a 50/50 premium contribution basis, an auto-enrolment pension scheme, 20 days' annual leave plus Bank Holidays increasing to 25 days over time, staff and family discounts, a Refer a Friend Scheme, and a Driving Lesson Assistance Scheme providing financial support towards driving lessons.

If you are interested, please do not hesitate to apply online. We would love to hear from you.
